title: 유한책임신탁등기규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:03170:20241129:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Commercial Registration Rules) <No. 3170, November 29, 2024>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on January 31, 2025. <Proviso omitted>
Articles 2 through 7 Omitted.
Article 8 (Amendment of Other Rules) (1) Omitted.
(2) Part of the Rules on Registration of Limited Liability Trusts shall be amended as follows:
In the latter part of Article 3, "his or her date of birth" shall be replaced with "his or her alien registration number, domestic residence report number, or date of birth."
In Article 8, "Article 14 (1)" shall be replaced with "Articles 14 (1) and 28-2."
